stripe_relationship_evidence: Stripe application page identifies the company as Stripe and exposes a link labelled Greenhouse application for the same vacancy.
relationship_interpretation: Confirmed for the observed Stripe vacancy only; not blanket authorization for all 780 records.

thresholds.snapshot_consistency: Same frozen source record matches advertisement fields; no independence claim.
thresholds.fresh_ats_retrieval: Fresh response from the same ATS; establishes retrieval existence only, not independent employer authorization.
thresholds.employer_to_ats_relationship: Employer-controlled page directly links to or explicitly identifies the ATS; confirms a relationship for the observed evidence scope, not every vacancy.
thresholds.vacancy_level_official_confirmation: Employer-controlled page identifies the specific vacancy and agrees on identifier plus core details.
thresholds.independent_authorization_support: Requires vacancy-level official confirmation plus an established employer-to-ATS relationship, with provenance showing the sources are not merely the same derived snapshot.

source_independence_rule: A fresh retrieval from Greenhouse is retrieval-independent from the frozen snapshot but not a separate independent employer source.
limitations: The 20-case pilot belongs to the separate Naukri/ATS cohort; it is not the Stripe/Greenhouse 780-record cohort.
